lines: Anaykumar Avinash Joshi holds shares valued at ₹79.90 crore (estimate, valued at offer price), shares not cash.
Promoter shares above the 20% unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago, so this trigger is recent.
Minimum Promoters' Contribution is locked until 9 Sep 2027; how many shares unlocked is unknown.
They hold 591,000 shares before the offer and are not selling in it, so the retained stake is the call point.
